added.summary: A nine-slice image may set `tint: true`: a shape the element's fill colours (its alpha kept), so a chamfered plate follows the theme in either scheme; unset, the image is a picture drawn as it is. The built-in fantasy pack names its filigree frame and its iron and red button plates as images, and scifi its corner-bracket frame (per scheme) and its chamfered frame, plate, button, cell, chip and field cuts.
